judge_inputs: Inspect the actual service,normal canonical reports,command traces and source-bound evidence. No synthetic observation overlay is supplied. This stage verifies the actual instrumented pipeline workspace when preconditions are supplied. Execute the bound scenarios/read-only application checks and produce current verification evidence. If a standalone invocation genuinely lacks its canonical audit/selection,report that exact blocker without fabricating a pass or editing application code. A prerequisite-negative control is not positive runtime proof.

For positive implementation/verification,inspect raw .observe/logging-workflow-proof evidence,actual stdout/stderr and exact received span/log joins from the unchanged host checker. The independent pipeline also reruns that checker;self-reported success alone is insufficient.

Return exactly one check per criterion with IDs rubric-1 through rubric-14. Keep unselected/unsupported and unexecuted cases honest;do not require optional app features solely because a reference mentions them.

Prerequisite-negative applicability: inspect the actual service and canonical files first. Only when this is the untouched uninstrumented standalone fixture and its required audit/selection are genuinely absent, the correct outcome is the exact prerequisite blocker with no application edits, fabricated reports or runtime pass. For that negative control, rubric-3 through rubric-14 have no executable instrumentation claims to assess: mark them satisfied only with explicit Not applicable: prerequisite-negative; no runtime coverage credit notes and verified absence of contrary claims. Do not demand post-gate source analysis or tests that the skill correctly refused to run. This exception is forbidden in the paired workflow when the actual canonical audit/selection and instrumented service exist; all applicable positive obligations and real checker evidence remain required there.
rubric: Uses the requested loaded skill against the actual service and its current state. Distinguishes source/config/default evidence from executed telemetry;does not use imagined overlay observations or fabricated outcomes. This stage verifies the actual instrumented pipeline workspace when preconditions are supplied. Execute the bound scenarios/read-only application checks and produce current verification evidence. If a standalone invocation genuinely lacks its canonical audit/selection,report that exact blocker without fabricating a pass or editing application code. A prerequisite-negative control is not positive runtime proof.

Follows the canonical audit,selection,instrumentation and verification contract applicable to this stage. Keeps audit baseline immutable during implementation/verification and binds selection/results to the actual current contract;does not invent IDs or preconditions.

Identifies actual native logging,SDK/agent/provider/bridge ownership and startup reachability. Uses one supported owner per record,retains original sinks and does not infer a working pipeline from environment variables alone.

Preserves record semantics:actual WARN mapping,source occurrence versus observed time,bounded useful bodies and supported structured values. Does not invent mandatory EventName,exception payloads or unsupported SDK capabilities.

Requires or proves canonical log TraceId and SpanId joins to exact real SDK spans,with parentage and source-backed Resource identity. Ordinary attributes,nonempty IDs,shared TraceId or stdout correlation alone are insufficient.

Addresses the actual owned executor/goroutine/callback path and concurrent left/right request pairing. Reuses verified Java/Node propagation;identifies or repairs missing Go request-context and Python executor propagation. Separate sync and async probes cannot prove the same worker-to-real-span path.
Distinguishes legitimate outside-span/unsampled context from broken wiring. No stale request IDs on startup logs,no fabricated spans/forced sampling,and explicit uncertainty for unexecuted cases.

Applies source-backed privacy and exception scope without introducing raw request IDs,unbounded errors or unsupported alias requirements. Bounded left/right categories are permitted;ordinary native messages do not require instrumentation-only exception events. When a selected privacy probe exposes framework/access/error renderer content captured by the path, do not defer it merely as dependency-owned. Preserve permitted diagnostic category, effective level, sinks and application behavior while removing policy-forbidden values at the policy-selected boundary; blanket suppression is not redaction. Inspect a supported native hook or explicitly leave a genuinely unsupported boundary unresolved, then rerun the actual failing probe in native and OTLP output.

Assesses applicable log/Body limits and construction costs against actual defaults and selected requirements. No span-limit substitution,mandatory arbitrary new cap,provider replacement or expensive guard on every cheap fixed-message call.

Keeps delivery evidence accurate:batch/lifecycle owner,effective deadlines,healthy one-per-call receipts versus transport retries,and attempted/accepted/rejected/dropped/unknown distinctions. Does not promote enqueue,HTTP success or a source default into receiver proof. Completed negative OTLP responses must be classified separately from an unacknowledged stall. Record observed retry exhaustion and retain acceptance uncertainty where evidence or the protocol leaves it unresolved, including response-size failures. For a valid partial response with N known records and R rejected, explicitly account for N-R acknowledged accepted and R rejected, without equating either with backend persistence or received copies; populated partial success must not be retried, including warning-only zero rejection.

Checks applicable diagnostic routing and configured-signal isolation. Source review or healthy traffic does not establish an outage test;unexecuted fault/optional SDK cases remain explicitly unproven instead of fabricated passes.

Uses fresh source/command/dependency-bound evidence with actual outcome counts and retained failures. Honors required project runtime and configured local endpoints. A copied old receipt,stale source or zero exit without execution cannot establish current verification.

Preserves application routes,behavior,operator identity and original sinks;keeps local logs local and makes no unrequested SDK upgrades,cloud configuration or unrelated business instrumentation. Supported defaults and upstream library duties are not automatically missing application code.

Reconciles applicable official logging guidance by requirement strength,owner,capability and proof boundary in the normal report. Separates normative OTel requirements,recommendations,optional/Development features and local policy;does not claim full coverage with unmapped applicable obligations.
